|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Alderaan Consular Ship (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-80-Alderaan_Consular_Ship.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-alderaanconsularship-pre.gif]]) on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Alderaan Consular Ship (V) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB5-80-Alderaan_Consular_Ship-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “May add 3 pilots and 4 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Opponent must use +2 Force to initiate battle here. Once per game, may ▼ a senator aboard.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 49). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Alderaan Consular Ship (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Alderaan Consular Ship (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “initiate a battle” for “initiate battle” (it writes ▼ out as “deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, which is notation only): “May add 3 pilots and 4 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Opponent must use +2 Force to initiate a battle here. Once per game, may deploy a senator aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”<ref name="cl-1250_79-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205224/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111153832/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
|hatnote=For the later errata text, see [[Alderaan Consular Ship (V) (Errata)]].
